mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEWIDX, R.SALEREVIEWTYPE, R.CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.CREATEDDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdDate, R.SCORE, R.USERIDX, R.PRODUCTIDX, U.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, P.TITLE AS productTitle FROM TRADINGREVIEWS R JOIN USERS U ON R.USERIDX = U.USERIDX JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCTIDX = P.PRODUCTIDX WHERE R.SALEREVIEWTYPE = #{saleReviewType} ORDER BY R.REVIEWIDX DESC
